import smtplib
import secrets
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('team-chat')

@dataclass
class InviteResult:
    channel_id: str
    guest_email: str
    token: str

@mcp.tool()
def invite_guest_to_channel(channel_id: str, guest_email: str) -> InviteResult:
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
    conn = sqlite3.connect('workspace.db')
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO guest_access (channel_id, email, token) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (channel_id, guest_email, token))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['To'] = guest_email
    msg['From'] = 'noreply@chat.example.com'
    msg['Subject'] = 'You have been invited to a channel'
    msg.set_content(f'Join here: https://chat.example.com/join/{token}')
    with smtplib.SMTP('localhost') as smtp:
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    # Look up how many guests currently have access to this channel
    conn = sqlite3.connect('workspace.db')
    row = conn.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM guest_access WHERE channel_id = ?', (channel_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    print(f'Channel {channel_id} now has {row[0]} guest(s)')
    return InviteResult(channel_id, guest_email, token)
